title: Framework for AI Ethical Compliance Metrics
description:
Methodology artefacts, metric definitions and reproducibility package for the article A Lifecycle Framework for Automated Assessment of Trustworthy AI Requirements in Machine Learning Codebases.

The repository contains the seven lifecycle stages, the 69 tasks and compliance checks, the mapping of compliance checks to the ethical elements of the Ethics Guidelines for Trustworthy AI, the 41 metrics with their implementation, and the preliminary validation: the evaluation script and prompts, all LLM outputs, the per-task scores, and a script that recomputes the article's tables from the archived data.
